caveats: Exact member roster not published in sources gathered; '16 organizations' figure is a protester attribution relayed by Fox News and remains unverified.

data.description: Dallas-area progressive activist coalition (also abbreviated DATA coalition) that organized the Sept. 10, 2026 march from Pike Park toward the American Airlines Center during the RNC midterm convention. Permitted-march applicant in early August 2026; city later canceled the special event permit. Reported by Fox News (attribution to a protester, unverified) as consisting of 16 faith-based, pro-immigrant-rights and labor organizations.
data.name: Dallas Against the Trump Agenda Coalition
